name: verdandi-framesplit

provenance.tool: shell framesplit-window (shell/framesplit.rs court over the GDI surface appended to shell/win32.rs) + verify/framesplit.py
provenance.surface: shell/framesplit.rs court over the GDI window (StretchDIBits + DwmFlush, QPC) surface

validity_scope.certifies: the render-start -> frame-ready interval of the shell's frame on host DANIELDILLBERG split into 7 phases for the production (T=8) and single-thread arms, with the uninstrumented envelope beside it, locked phase origin, 300 samples per cell over 4 frames

forbidden_interpretations: input-to-photon latency: input transport and panel scan-out need capture hardware
a comparison with any emit p99 (a different apparatus and observable)
that a phase's share is its cost outside this frame (the shares are p99s of one interval, and p99s do not add)
that the instrumentation tax is zero: it is measured and reported, and a VOID reading refuses attribution
a split of the time AFTER frame-ready (the composition wait) — that is frame-ready -> composited, kept as an anchor
that the seat names an optimization that will work: it names where the time is, not what will remove it
any other host, session, panel, window size or phase origin; absolute us are host-specific
reading: FRAME-SPLIT-0 on host DANIELDILLBERG (locked phase origin, 300 samples per cell, refresh 13363 us, context only). Production envelope render-start -> frame-ready p50 15690 us / p99 17863 us. production: NO SEAT — multi-component: no phase reaches 500 permille, none is promoted. p99 shares of the envelope (permille): strips 9, frame 251, floor_swizzle 7, emit 272, hud 7, bgr 139, blit 434. Tax -154 us at p50 (9 permille of the envelope) and -42 us at p99; the phase p50s sum to 15534 us against a split total of 15536 us (medians do not add; the 2 us gap is reported, not distributed). Context, no seat: single_thread: NO SEAT — multi-component: no phase reaches 500 permille, none is promoted. p99 shares of the envelope (permille): strips 7, frame 211, floor_swizzle 9, emit 367, hud 2, bgr 95, blit 385. Tax 51 us at p50 (2 permille of the envelope) and -790 us at p99; the phase p50s sum to 18731 us against a split total of 18503 us (medians do not add; the -228 us gap is reported, not distributed). Not input-to-photon; never compared to an emit p99; within this apparatus only.
